en.headline: Clean up photos and calendars
en.lead: Review duplicate photos and unwanted calendar events before removing them. Foliover also compresses images, adds timestamps and prepares photo print sheets.
en.note: Five on-device tools. No app account required.
en.hero_alt: Foliover home screen showing its photo, calendar, timestamp, print and compression tools
en.features_title: Free up space and manage calendar clutter
en.features_intro: Choose a tool for the task at hand and review its results before making changes.
features: Find duplicate and similar photos
Review matching photos, screenshots, large items and videos. Confirm what to remove. Photos go to Recently Deleted.
Review unwanted calendar events
Scan a date range for duplicates, suspicious invitations and subscriptions. Select editable events individually or in a batch.
Resize, stamp and print photos
Compress or convert images, add a visible date and time, or crop a portrait and arrange copies on a print sheet.
en.example_text: Finished photo exports appear in Your work. Reopen them to share an image or review an earlier result.
example_points: Timestamping saves a new copy, so your original stays in Photos.
Photo & Print supports JPG, PNG and PDF exports.
en.example_alt: Foliover’s Your work gallery with completed photo, timestamp and compression exports
questions: Does Foliover delete duplicate photos automatically?
You review the results and choose what to remove. Confirmed removals go to Recently Deleted in Photos.
Can Foliover remove a subscribed calendar?
Read-only subscriptions may need to be removed in Apple’s Calendar app. Use the scan to identify the source first.
How do the free use and lifetime unlock work?
Each tool includes one free successful use. A completed optional share can add one use for that tool, or you can choose a one-time unlock.
en.closing: Review your photos and calendar with Foliover

zh.platform: iPhone 与 iPad · iOS 17 或更高版本
zh.headline: 整理重复照片和日历
zh.lead: 先查看重复照片和不需要的日历事件，再决定删除哪些。也可以压缩图片、添加时间戳和制作打印排版。
zh.note: 五项工具均在本机运行，无需注册账号。
zh.hero_alt: Foliover 首页，展示照片、日历、时间戳、打印和压缩工具
zh.features_title: 释放照片空间，整理日历杂项
zh.features_intro: 按任务选择工具。清理前可以查看扫描结果。
features: 查找重复和相似照片
查看相似照片、截图、大文件和视频，确认后移除。被移除的照片进入系统相册的「最近删除」。
检查不需要的日历事件
按日期范围查找重复事件、可疑邀请和订阅。可以逐条或批量选择可编辑的事件。
压缩、加时间戳和排版
压缩图片、调整尺寸或转换格式，给照片添加可见的日期和时间，或裁剪人像并排版打印。
zh.example_text: 完成的照片导出会出现在「你的作品」里。之后还可以再次打开、核对或分享。
example_points: 添加时间戳会生成新副本，原图留在系统相册。
照片与打印支持导出 JPG、PNG 或 PDF。
zh.example_alt: Foliover「你的作品」界面，展示照片、时间戳和压缩导出
zh.faq_title: 照片和日历清理常见问题
questions: Foliover 会自动删除重复照片吗？
先由你复核并选择要移除的项目。确认移除后，照片进入系统相册的「最近删除」。
能直接移除订阅日历吗？
可以用扫描结果识别来源，只读订阅可能需要在 Apple 日历中取消订阅。
免费使用和终身解锁怎么算？
每项工具含一次成功的免费使用。完成一次可选分享可增加该工具的一次使用，也可一次性购买解锁。
zh.closing: 用 Foliover 检查照片和日历

en.headline: Three daily logic puzzles
en.lead: Draw a path, balance suns and moons, and place crowns. Everyone gets the same three puzzles each day, and each has a unique solution.
en.note: Daily puzzles are free. Core play works offline.
en.hero_alt: Trio’s Today screen listing Trace, Lumen and Crowns
en.features_intro: Each puzzle has its own rule set. The daily set gets more challenging as the week goes on.
features: Trace
Draw one continuous path through the numbers in order and cover every cell.
Lumen
Balance suns and moons in each line. Avoid three in a row and follow the equals and crosses clues.
Crowns
Place one crown per row, column and color region. Crowns may not touch, even diagonally.
en.example_text: Try spotting a restricted color region before placing a crown. A placement rules out the rest of its row and column as well as every neighboring square.
example_points: Compare solve times or share a result card for the same daily board.
Use hints and practice when you want to work on a particular puzzle.
en.example_alt: A colored Crowns puzzle grid in Trio with several crowns placed
questions: Can I play today’s puzzles offline?
Core play works offline and requires no account. Private iCloud progress sync is optional.
What does Trio Pro unlock?
The one-time purchase opens the past puzzle archive, unlimited practice and hints, and more detailed statistics.
Does every puzzle have a unique solution?
Yes. Every daily puzzle is verified to have exactly one solution.

zh.headline: 每天三道逻辑谜题
zh.lead: 一笔连路径、平衡太阳和月亮、在棋盘上放皇冠。全球玩家每天做同样三道题，每题只有一个解。
zh.note: 每日谜题免费，核心玩法支持离线。
zh.hero_alt: Trio 今日页面，列出 Trace、Lumen 和 Crowns
zh.features_title: Trace、Lumen 和 Crowns 怎么玩
zh.features_intro: 三种谜题各有自己的规则，一周内的每日题目会逐渐变难。
features: Trace 路径
从起点按数字顺序画出一条连续路线，并覆盖每个格子。
Lumen 日月
让每行每列的太阳和月亮数量相等，避免连续三个相同符号，同时遵循等号和叉号提示。
Crowns 皇冠
每行、每列和每个色块各放一顶皇冠，两顶皇冠不能相邻，包括对角线。
zh.example_text: 先观察位置很受限的色块。放下一顶皇冠后，就可以排除它所在行、列，以及四周相邻的格子。
example_points: 同一天的棋盘完全相同，可以比较解题用时或分享成绩卡。
想熟悉某一种题时，可以使用提示和练习。
zh.example_alt: Trio 皇冠谜题彩色棋盘，已有部分皇冠落位
questions: 每日谜题可以离线玩吗？
核心玩法支持离线，无需账号。可以按需使用私人 iCloud 同步进度。
Trio Pro 解锁什么？
一次性购买可解锁往期题库、无限练习和提示，以及更详细的统计。
每道题都有唯一解吗？
有。每日谜题都经过验证，每道题只有一个解。

en.headline: Connect the dots without a timer
en.lead: Link matching colors without crossing lines, then fill the board for a Perfect result. Play 999 levels or take on the daily puzzle.
en.note: Offline play · No ads · Optional one-time Pro unlock
en.hero_alt: Knots connect-the-dots puzzle with colored endpoints and partly connected paths
en.features_intro: Start with a small grid and work up to larger boards at your own pace.
features: Connect matching colors
Trace a path between each pair. Keep paths from crossing and leave room for the other colors.
Fill the whole grid
A Perfect result uses every cell. Grids range from 5 × 5 to 12 × 12.
Play daily or offline
Take on the same daily puzzle as everyone else, use a hint when stuck, or play a level away from the internet.
en.example_text: Open Daily Challenge for a fresh board. Finish it to build a streak and review previous results in History.
example_points: Regular levels let you practice at your own pace.
Knots Pro adds all levels, unlimited hints and Endless Mode.
en.example_alt: Knots Daily Challenge screen with a play button, streak and history
questions: What counts as Perfect in Knots?
Connect each matching pair and fill every square. You can rearrange paths if the connections leave unused cells.
Can I play without a time limit?
Yes. Regular play has no timer, and the app supports offline play.
Is Knots Pro a subscription?
It’s an optional one-time purchase. Knots does not run ads.
en.closing: Find a few quiet minutes for Knots

zh.platform: iPhone 与 iPad · iOS 17 或更高版本
zh.headline: 没有计时的同色连线谜题
zh.lead: 连接同色圆点，让路线互不交叉。铺满棋盘就能拿到完美成绩。可以玩 999 个关卡，也可以挑战每日谜题。
zh.note: 支持离线 · 无广告 · 可选一次性 Pro 解锁
zh.hero_alt: Knots 同色连线棋盘，部分彩色圆点已连接
zh.features_title: 慢慢连接，直到铺满棋盘
zh.features_intro: 从小棋盘开始，按自己的节奏挑战更大的棋盘。
features: 连接同色圆点
给每对圆点画出一条线路。路线不能交叉，也要给其他颜色留出空间。
用完每个格子
铺满整个棋盘可获得完美成绩。棋盘从 5 × 5 到 12 × 12。
每日挑战与离线关卡
挑战全球同题，卡住时使用提示，没网时也可以玩已解锁关卡。
zh.example_text: 打开每日挑战即可开始当天的谜题。完成后可以累积连胜，并在历史记录中查看成绩。
example_points: 普通关卡可以慢慢练习，无需赶时间。
Knots Pro 解锁全部关卡、无限提示和无尽模式。
zh.example_alt: Knots 每日挑战页面，展示开始按钮、连胜和历史入口
questions: 怎样才能拿到完美成绩？
连接所有同色圆点，并让线路覆盖每一格。连通后还有空格时，可以重新调整走线。
可以不限时间地玩吗？
可以，普通关卡没有计时，应用支持离线。
Knots Pro 需要订阅吗？
Pro 是可选的一次性购买。Knots 没有广告。

en.headline: Track perfume samples and wear tests
en.lead: Give each sample a place in your collection. Keep first impressions and later notes together, then decide what to try again or buy.
en.note: Works offline. Private iCloud sync is optional.
en.hero_alt: Scentory sample box screen showing a photo of the vial organizer and two saved perfume samples
en.features_title: From sample box to scent journal
en.features_intro: Find the vial you want, record how it wears, and keep your own reasons for a decision.
features: Organize and find samples
Group vials into boxes, add photos or position numbers, and search your collection. You can also mark a position on your own box photo.
Record a perfume wear test
Keep the first impression and later observations in the same trial. Add scent tags, a note, or an optional reminder to revisit it.
Decide whether to buy a bottle
Mark a sample to keep, retry, pass on or buy. Revisit your reasons and earlier decisions in the timeline.
en.example_title: What did the scent smell like later?
en.example_text: Open an existing trial to add how the fragrance changed after the first spray. Keeping the observations together makes a later retest easier to compare.
example_points: Try a suggestion from your own untested or recently loved samples.
Browse the bundled perfume catalog offline, or add your own sample.
en.example_alt: Scentory fragrance impression form with sample details, feelings, scent tags and notes
questions: Do I need a catalog entry for each sample?
No. Add a sample manually, or look it up in the bundled offline catalog.
Can I use Scentory without iCloud?
Yes. Records can stay on your device. Private iCloud sync is optional, and Scentory can export JSON backups.
How many samples can I start with?
The free plan includes ten samples, the default box and one custom box. Scentory Pro removes sample and custom-box limits.
en.closing: Start a journal for your samples

zh.headline: 整理香水小样，记录每次试香
zh.lead: 给小样安排位置，把初闻和后续感受记在一起，再决定要复试、留样还是买正装。
zh.note: 支持离线，私人 iCloud 同步可选。
zh.hero_alt: Scentory 小样盒界面，显示小样盒照片和两支已记录的小样
zh.features_title: 从小样收纳到试香笔记
zh.features_intro: 找到想试的小样，记下香气怎样变化，保存每个决定的理由。
features: 收纳并查找香水小样
用样盒分组，添加照片和位置编号，或直接在自己的样盒照片上标注位置。
记录香水的留香变化
把初闻和后续观察记在同一次试香中，加上气味标签、笔记或可选的回访提醒。
决定是否买正装
为小样记录留样、复试、放弃或购买正装。需要时按时间线回看原因与旧决定。
zh.example_title: 几小时后闻起来怎么样？
zh.example_text: 打开同一次试香，补记香气后来的变化。把不同时段的感受放在一起，复试时方便对照。
example_points: 从已有小样中挑一支没试过、适合复试或最近喜欢的。
内置香水目录可以离线浏览，也支持手动添加小样。
zh.example_alt: Scentory 试香感受表单，可记录小样、感受、气味标签和备注
zh.faq_title: 小样管理与试香常见问题
questions: 目录里没有的香水可以添加吗？
可以手动加小样，也可以从内置离线目录选择。
可以关掉 iCloud 用吗？
可以只用本机存储。私人 iCloud 同步可选，也可以导出 JSON 备份。
免费可以记录多少小样？
免费包含 10 支小样、默认样盒和一个自定义样盒。Scentory Pro 可解除小样和自定义样盒限制。
zh.closing: 给你的小样建一本笔记

en.headline: Build habits one quest at a time
en.lead: Check off recurring habits, break longer goals into steps, and see each bit of progress bring Mochi’s world to life.
en.note: Free · No ads or in-app purchases · Your records stay on-device
en.jump: See how habits and goals work
en.hero_alt: Daily Quest Today screen with recurring habits and an entry to Mochi Home
en.features_title: Track a daily habit or work toward a finish line
en.features_intro: Use a recurring habit for things you want to keep doing and a goal expedition for a target you can finish.
features: Check off repeating habits
Set a habit to repeat daily, on selected weekdays or every few days. Review streaks and recent check-ins.
Plan a goal expedition
Set a deadline and target count. Record one step at a time and see how far you still have to go.
See progress with Mochi
Daily check-ins help Mochi grow and goals unlock places in its world. Local reminders and Live Activities help you see what’s next.
en.example_title: Turn a goal into steps you can count
en.example_text: Use an expedition for a goal like reading twelve books by the end of the year. Pick a target and deadline, then log each finished book.
example_points: Review active and completed goals together.
Use a repeating habit, such as reading for ten minutes, if the routine itself is what you want to track.
en.example_alt: Daily Quest Goal Expeditions screen showing active and recently completed goals and progress bars
questions: Can I set habits for particular days?
Yes. You can repeat a habit daily, on weekdays you choose, or at a set interval of days.
Can I see today’s habits from the Lock Screen?
On compatible devices, Live Activities show today’s progress on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
Do I need a Daily Quest account?
No. The app keeps tasks and progress on your device and has no ads or in-app purchases.

zh.platform: iPhone 与 iPad · iOS 17 或更高版本
zh.headline: 把习惯和目标变成每日任务
zh.lead: 为重复习惯打卡，把长期目标拆成小步。每一点进度都能帮助 Mochi 和它的世界成长。
zh.note: 免费 · 无广告及应用内购买 · 记录保存在本机
zh.jump: 看看习惯和目标怎么记录
zh.hero_alt: 每日任务的今日打卡页面，展示重复习惯和 Mochi 小屋入口，英文界面
zh.features_title: 既能坚持习惯，也能完成目标
zh.features_intro: 想持续做的事可以设为习惯，有完成期限和次数的事可以设为目标探险。
features: 为重复习惯打卡
设置每天、指定星期或每隔几天重复，回顾连胜和近期记录。
为目标安排探险
设定次数和截止日期，每完成一步就记一次，随时看剩余进度。
看 Mochi 随进度成长
习惯打卡帮助 Mochi 成长，目标进度能解锁新地点。本地提醒和实时活动方便查看下一项任务。
zh.example_title: 把长期目标拆成可记录的步骤
zh.example_text: 例如想在年底前读完 12 本书，可以建一个目标探险，设置目标次数和截止日期，每读完一本记一次。
example_points: 进行中和已完成的目标可以一起回看。
如果只是想每天读 10 分钟，可以另设为重复习惯。
zh.example_alt: 每日任务的目标探险页面，展示进行中、已完成的目标及进度条，英文界面
zh.enlarge: 查看完整截图（英文界面）
zh.faq_title: 习惯打卡和目标记录常见问题
questions: 习惯可以只在指定星期提醒吗？
可以。重复频率可选每天、指定星期或每隔几天，再为需要的习惯设置本地提醒。
可以在锁屏查看今日进度吗？
在兼容机型上可以用实时活动查看今日进度，支持锁屏和灵动岛。
使用每日任务需要账号吗？
无需账号。任务和进度保存在本机，应用没有广告或应用内购买。
zh.closing: 和 Mochi 一起开始第一个习惯

en.headline: Track home care, receipts and warranties
en.lead: Keep a receipt with the thing it belongs to. Set return reminders and schedule maintenance for appliances or vehicles by date, mileage or both.
en.note: Records and text recognition stay on your device.
en.jump: See how to track an item
en.hero_alt: HomeCue home dashboard with everyday care, receipts, returns, warranties and care history
en.features_title: Give every item a care record
en.features_intro: Start with one of 48 illustrated templates, then confirm the details and care tasks that apply to your equipment.
features: Schedule maintenance by date or mileage
Set a date, a mileage threshold or whichever comes first. Use the manufacturer’s instructions to choose the right interval.
Scan receipts and link them to items
Scan several pages or add photos or PDFs. Text recognition runs on-device, and a single receipt can link to several items.
Remember returns and warranties
Set a return deadline, track partial returns, and keep warranty dates, manuals and service history together.
en.example_title: Find purchase proof when you need it
en.example_text: Open an item to see its receipt, return deadline and service history. Keep the original proof alongside the details you have reviewed.
example_points: Attach photos, invoices or other documents to service records.
Share records as a PDF or export a complete local backup.
en.example_alt: HomeCue purchase proof screen with an example receipt, its stored details and items linked to it
questions: Can I track vehicle maintenance by mileage?
Yes. Use a mileage threshold or pair it with a date. Update the recorded vehicle mileage so HomeCue can show how close you are to the next service.
Can I link one receipt to multiple items?
Yes. A receipt can be linked to several items, and returns can be tracked item by item.
Does HomeCue sync to other devices?
HomeCue stores records locally. You can export and restore a backup. Check your App Store for current pricing and unlock availability.
en.closing: Start a record for the things you own

zh.platform: iPhone 与 iPad · iOS 17 或更高版本
zh.headline: 家居维护、收据和保修一起管
zh.lead: 把收据归到对应物品，设置退货提醒，按日期或里程安排家电和车辆保养。
zh.note: 记录和收据文字识别均在本机处理。
zh.hero_alt: HomeCue 首页，包含日常维护、收据归档、退货提醒、保修管理和维护记录
zh.features_title: 为每件物品建一份维护记录
zh.features_intro: 从 48 个插画模板任选其一，再核对适用于你设备的资料和维护事项。
features: 按日期或里程安排维护
可按日期、里程或先到的一项规划维护。具体保养间隔请参考设备或车辆厂商的说明。
扫描收据并关联物品
可扫描多页，或添加图片、PDF。在本机识别文字，一张收据也能关联多件物品。
记下退货截止日与保修
设置退货提醒，记下部分退货，并把保修日期、说明书和维修历史保存在同一处。
zh.example_title: 需要时能找到购买凭证
zh.example_text: 打开对应物品即可查看收据、退货截止日和维护历史。保留原始凭证，也能随时查看自己核对过的资料。
example_points: 维护记录可以附加照片、账单等文件。
可分享 PDF 记录，或导出完整的本机备份。
zh.example_alt: HomeCue 的购买凭证页面，展示示例收据、购买资料和关联物品
zh.faq_title: 维护和收据管理常见问题
questions: 可以按里程提醒汽车保养吗？
可以选里程条件，或同时设置日期。更新当前里程后，HomeCue 能据此显示离下次保养还有多远。
一张收据可以关联多个物品吗？
可以关联多件物品，并分别记录退货。
HomeCue 支持跨设备同步吗？
记录保存在本机，可通过备份导出和恢复。当前价格和解锁方式请查看所在地区的 App Store。
zh.closing: 为你拥有的物品建一份记录

en.headline: A private journal for the people you love
en.lead: Bring each person’s photos, memories and birthday into one place. Set reminders for important dates and file personal documents by person.
en.note: Records and imported media stay on your iPhone.
en.hero_alt: Family & Friends Journal home screen with sample family profiles and photos
en.features_intro: Make a private profile for a parent, partner, child or close friend, and add only what you want to remember.
features: Create a profile and photo journal
Add a photo or Live Photo cover, keep moments with photos and videos, and use custom fields for details worth remembering.
Remember Gregorian or lunar birthdays
Record birthdays and other important dates. Schedule local reminders and add selected dates to Apple Calendar when you choose.
File personal documents by person
Scan, photograph or import documents. You can hide selected profiles behind a private-record password.
en.example_title: See important dates at a glance
en.example_text: Open Important Dates to see upcoming birthdays and anniversaries with the person each date belongs to. Set reminders for the dates that matter to you.
example_points: Gregorian and lunar birthdays can sit together in the same journal.
Calendar export is optional.
en.example_alt: Family & Friends Journal Important Dates screen with sample birthdays and anniversaries
questions: Can I set reminders for lunar birthdays?
Yes. The app supports both Gregorian and lunar birthdays and can schedule local reminders.
Are my photos uploaded to a server?
The app has no developer-operated server. Version 1.0 keeps profiles and imported media on your iPhone, with iCloud sync disabled.
How many people can I add?
The free plan includes three people and ten media items per person. The optional one-time Pro purchase removes those limits.
en.closing: Start a journal for someone close

zh.headline: 为亲友留一本私密日记
zh.lead: 把每位亲友的照片、回忆和生日放在一起，设置重要日期提醒，也能按人归档私人文件。
zh.note: 人物档案和导入的媒体保存在 iPhone 上。
zh.hero_alt: Family & Friends Journal 首页，展示示例亲友档案与照片
zh.features_title: 把照片、回忆和重要日期放在一起
zh.features_intro: 为父母、伴侣、孩子或好朋友建档，记下你想保留的点滴。
features: 建立人物档案与相册
设置照片或实况照片封面，用照片和视频保存共同回忆，也可用自定义字段记下重要细节。
记录公历与农历生日
保存生日和其他重要日期，在本机设置提醒，也可以按需添加到 Apple 日历。
按人物归档私人文件
扫描、拍摄或导入文件。可以将指定人物设为私密档案，用专用密码查看。
zh.example_title: 一眼看见快到的重要日期
zh.example_text: 打开「重要日期」，查看接下来的生日和纪念日以及对应人物。只为想提醒的日期设置通知。
example_points: 公历和农历生日可以放在同一本日记里。
按需导出到 Apple 日历。
zh.example_alt: Family & Friends Journal 的重要日期列表，展示示例生日和纪念日
questions: 农历生日可以设置提醒吗？
可以。应用支持公历、农历生日，以及本地日期提醒。
亲友照片会上传到服务器吗？
应用没有开发者服务器。1.0 版的档案和导入媒体保存在 iPhone 上，暂未启用 iCloud 同步。
免费可以添加几个人？
免费支持 3 人，每人可添加 10 个媒体项目。可选的一次性 Pro 购买会解除这两项限制。
zh.closing: 为一位亲友建一本日记

en.headline: Build a daily no-spend habit
en.lead: Check in when you avoid extra spending, note a purchase you skipped, and grow a virtual plant while you work on a savings challenge.
en.note: No bank connection or developer account required.
en.jump: See how a savings challenge works
en.hero_alt: Dewday home screen showing a no-spend streak, a check-in and an estimated amount kept
en.features_title: Track spending choices and set a savings challenge
en.features_intro: Start with a daily check-in or choose an amount to set aside yourself.
features: Check in on no-spend days
Record no spending, essentials only, or other spending. Use the calendar to see streaks or correct a past entry.
Set a savings challenge
Choose seven days, one calendar month or one calendar year. Set a daily amount and a personal reward.
Log purchases you skipped
Record something you chose not to buy and what it would have cost. Share progress cards and earn virtual growth as you go.
en.example_text: For example, set a personal target of $5 a day for seven days and set the money aside yourself. Record each day in Dewday and watch your plant grow.
example_points: The seven-day target in that example is $35.
Dewday records your progress. It does not move money or read bank balances.
en.example_alt: Dewday challenge planner offering a seven-day, monthly or yearly challenge with a custom daily amount
questions: Do I need to connect a bank account?
No. You enter spending choices and amounts yourself. The estimated amount kept is a record, not a bank balance.
Can I fill in a check-in I missed?
Yes. Review and edit past check-ins in the calendar.
How do I keep access after the first day?
After the initial 24 hours, continued use is available through a subscription or an optional completed share to unlock the current day. Historical records remain viewable.

zh.headline: 养成每日不花钱打卡习惯
zh.lead: 记录没有额外花费的日子和忍住没买的东西。参加存钱挑战，让虚拟植物随打卡慢慢长大。
zh.note: 无需连接银行账户或注册开发者账号。
zh.hero_alt: Dewday 首页，展示不花钱连胜、打卡入口以及估算省下的金额
zh.features_title: 记录花费选择，设定存钱挑战
zh.features_intro: 可以先从每天打卡开始，也可以设定每天由自己存下的金额。
features: 给不花钱的日子打卡
记录不花钱、仅必需支出或其他支出。在日历里查看连胜，也能补记或更正。
给自己设一个存钱挑战
选择 7 天、一个自然月或一个自然年，自己定每天金额与完成奖励。
记下忍住没买的东西
记录想买但没买的物品和价格。打卡后可累计虚拟成长，也可以分享进度卡片。
zh.example_title: 从一个 7 天存钱挑战开始
zh.example_text: 例如计划连续 7 天每天存下 5 元，由自己把钱留出来，再在 Dewday 里记下每一天，看植物慢慢长大。
example_points: 这个例子的 7 天目标是 35 元。
Dewday 只记录进度，应用不会转账或读取银行余额。
zh.example_alt: Dewday 存钱挑战设置，提供 7 天、一个月和一年选项及自定义每日金额
zh.faq_title: 不花钱打卡和存钱挑战常见问题
questions: 需要绑定银行卡吗？
不用。消费选择和金额由你填写，页面展示的省钱金额是估算记录。
忘了打卡可以补记吗？
可以在日历里查看、补记或更正过去的打卡。
最初 24 小时结束后怎么继续使用？
可选择订阅，也可以完成一次可选分享来解锁当天。历史记录仍然可以查看。
zh.closing: 开始第一次不花钱打卡
